# REWIND — Curated Vintage & Retro Sportswear

Hand-picked vintage tracksuits, retro jerseys, rare Lacoste zip-ups, and summer sets.
Each item authenticated, steam-cleaned, and shipped within 24 hours from Belgium.
10–25 day delivery. No returns. Sole proprietor, Belgium (BE).

## Key pages

- https://rewind-stores.com — Homepage with hero, shop grid, and categories
- https://rewind-stores.com/sitemap.xml — Full product sitemap for crawlers
- https://rewind-stores.com/robots.txt — Crawl directives
- https://rewind-stores.com/llms-full.txt — Full site documentation for AI agents

## Categories

- **Brasils** — Football-inspired jerseys with Brazilian/retro styling
- **Jerseys** — Retro sport jerseys (rugby, football, basketball)
- **Polos** — Polo shirts, terry, pique, rugby-style
- **Jumpers** — Knit jumpers, crewnecks, cardigans
- **Zip-up Jumpers** — Hooded or collar zip-ups, tracksuit top style
- **Tracksuits** — Full matching sets (top + pants)
- **Pants** — Track pants, cargo, sweatpants
- **Sets** — Coordinated two-piece outfits
- **Shoes** — Retro trainers, sneakers
- **Jackets** — Bomber, varsity, windbreakers, outerwear

## Brands

Fear of God, BAPE, Lacoste, CP Company, Denim Tears, Stone Island, Nike, Adidas, and more.

## API

- Product data sourced from Supabase (PostgreSQL). API endpoints at /api/*.
- Cart and checkout use Stripe (card, Bancontact, iDEAL, Klarna, PayPal).
- Chat support via /api/chat/* endpoints.

- Email: orders@rewind-stores.com

## Tech stack

- Frontend: React 18 + Vite (SPA)
- Backend: Express.js (Node)
- Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- Payments: Stripe
- Email: Resend
- Hosting: Railway
